invariants.rationale: The method returns a HoodieWriteMetadata object; unless an error occurs, it should not be null.
The write statuses list in the returned metadata should not be null, indicating the operation attempted to collect write results.
getWriteStatuses() is expected to return a List according to the generic HoodieWriteMetadata.
The size of the write status list cannot be negative.
partition-to-replace file ids are constructed as part of write metadata and should be non-null.
